pattern_explanation: Several Ukrainian words look almost identical to English words because both languages took them from the same classical roots. Over time the meanings drifted apart, so the similar spelling misleads learners who trust the look of the word instead of its meaning.
false_friend_warning: Learners may think the Ukrainian word fabryka matches the English word 'fabric', but it actually means 'factory'. Check the meaning rather than the spelling when you meet a familiar-looking word.
